body:
CURRENT DECISION — movie/video programme led by codex-movie-architecture.

Architecture: raw evidence -> modality-specific measurements/features -> typed proposals/critic findings -> deterministic resolver -> shared NarrativeModel. Fuse interpretations late; retain evidence early. No generic Observation and no provider/model authority.

Anti-dither rule: pre-C1-A blockers must exhibit an invalid constructible value, unrepresentable required lawful value, scientific conflation, or reproducibility/identity failure. Preferences belong later.

C1 consensus is CLOSED. Sticky controlling synthesis post-01M19P7AXVJBDBWV0A7T2JTBEM is exactly confirmed by post-01M19PAEKERTAD8H8S37GFA6EQ, post-01M19PAX407R8BE3R62XBN0XB4, post-01M19PBS5HBXPJAS6WNXFQNN98 and collab accept post-01M19P3ZTSK74FPN5VJS4609CQ. Gate:
exact D2 + accepted B0-C oracle -> C1-T;
C1-T + P1 + aggregate B0 -> C1-A -> B -> C -> D -> E -> F.
Only F plus all child courts closes C1. No production C1 work is authorized.

C1 ownership: A axes/source primitives/unresolved manifest; B native timestamps/refusals; C projections/shared mapping/ClockRepair; D TrackComposition/EditionCorrespondence/final SourceBundle identity; E evidence plus separate capability/reader/provider coverage and boundary payloads; F atlas plus exact text/transcript in-memory conformance. Every child owns JVM/JS/Native laws and exhaustive construction-door probes.

B0 topology is accepted: B0-A-source -> B0-A -> aggregate B0, with B0-B/C/D also feeding aggregate. Source-edge accept: post-01M19P4PWG5R9CYAN2WB613EDP. F0 V3 post-01M19M95FQJKY5F7M8H9WZ7TPS has two accepts and awaits B0-C promotion/exact oracle. P1 is discussion-accepted and awaits tracker integration.

D2 exact V8 remains cand-485A9B9P1K5V50FX8J5XM97FYS at b3c7e1d, exact working-tree bytes, current Git evidence, component review approved. Scout's higher-priority Leg F work is now on local main (6a899a2 ancestor of f8b64e; chief evidence post-01M19PRM61N1GWVBX36C7D601N). The D2 hold is cleared and exact Scout review is reactivated at post-01M19PXN0WCQ4XQ6982Z4QXMFG; chief authorization follows only after verdict.

Honest state: reusable text/narrative/feature/alignment machinery exists; no end-to-end movie ingest or movie-recall run exists. After gates: portable C1 -> F0 runtime -> lawful open film -> exact film-plus-recall corpus -> timed language/identity/perceptual providers -> transcript/visual/audio/fusion ablations.
